guideline_category: Adjacent Segment Disease (ASD) after Cervical Fusion

medical_necessity_criteria.criterion: Patient must have a history of cervical fusion.
documentation_required: Prior operative report detailing the cervical fusion procedure.
Imaging studies demonstrating prior cervical fusion (e.g., X-ray, CT, MRI).

medical_necessity_criteria.criterion: Patient must have a history of radiculopathy or myelopathy related to the fused segment.
documentation_required: Prior operative report detailing the cervical fusion procedure.
Imaging studies demonstrating prior cervical fusion (e.g., X-ray, CT, MRI).
Clinical documentation supporting radiculopathy or myelopathy symptoms (e.g., physician's notes, imaging reports).

medical_necessity_criteria.criterion: Patient must have evidence of adjacent segment disease (ASD) at the level below the fusion.
documentation_required: Imaging studies demonstrating ASD at the adjacent segment (e.g., X-ray, CT, MRI).
Clinical documentation supporting ASD symptoms (e.g., physician's notes, imaging reports).

medical_necessity_criteria.criterion: Patient must have clinical evidence of radiculopathy or myelopathy attributable to the adjacent segment disease.
documentation_required: Imaging studies demonstrating ASD at the adjacent segment (e.g., X-ray, CT, MRI).
Clinical documentation supporting radiculopathy or myelopathy symptoms (e.g., physician's notes, imaging reports).

medical_necessity_criteria.criterion: Patient must have failed conservative management for the ASD-related radiculopathy or myelopathy.
documentation_required: Clinical documentation detailing conservative treatment attempts (e.g., physical therapy records, physician's notes).
Imaging studies demonstrating ASD at the adjacent segment (e.g., X-ray, CT, MRI).

medical_necessity_criteria.criterion: Patient must have a history of smoking.
documentation_required: Laboratory test results showing cotinine levels above a specified threshold (e.g., > 10 ng/mL).

non_indications.scenario: Patient does not have a history of cervical fusion.
Patient does not have a history of radiculopathy or myelopathy related to the fused segment.
Patient does not have evidence of adjacent segment disease (ASD) at the level below the fusion.
Patient does not have clinical evidence of radiculopathy or myelopathy attributable to the adjacent segment disease.
Patient has failed conservative management for the ASD-related radiculopathy or myelopathy.
Patient does not have a history of smoking.

Policy Name: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)
Referred Sections: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)
Important criteria & exceptions: Patient must be nicotine-free prior to planned surgery verified by objective testing.
Absence of unmanaged significant behavioral or mental health disorders.
Non-Indications: Procedures performed before the required post-operative duration has elapsed (e.g., < 6 months from prior surgery).
Neck pain or radiculopathy without objective physical exam findings or concordant advanced imaging (MRI/CT).
Failure to complete the mandatory trial of conservative therapy (minimum 6 weeks of PT/medications) unless contraindicated.
Active tobacco or nicotine use without verified 6-week cessation and negative cotinine laboratory test.
Presence of unmanaged significant behavioral or mental health disorders, active opioid/alcohol use disorder, or secondary gain.
Documentation required: Operative reports from prior cervical decompression or fusion surgery (confirming levels and surgical date).
Plain cervical spine X-rays with flexion and extension lateral views showing fusion and stability.
Advanced imaging reports (MRI or CT of cervical spine) documenting neural structure compression or stenosis concordant with symptoms.
Detailed physical examination records documenting functional impairment and objective neurological deficits.
Physical therapy records and pharmacy prescription logs documenting >= 6 weeks of continuous conservative therapy.
Objective cotinine laboratory test results (serum, urine, or saliva) confirming nicotine-free status (or signed never-smoker attestation).
Behavioral/mental health evaluation notes confirming absence of unmanaged psychiatric or substance use disorders.
